block_identity.definitions: A=PHP on P-space; B=PHQ:Q->P; C=QHP=B*:P->Q; D=QHQ on Q-space
block_identity.trace_class_basis: B is Hilbert-Schmidt; B*B and B V_QQ B* are trace class; traces are on the finite P-space

claim_boundary: No m3=2, 0.105 conditioned-energy conclusion, prime-to-Weil transfer, or strict >79 theorem is claimed.
decision: B — scalar-background boundary sector is source-valid o(1); signed V-cubic boundary transfer remains open

independent_exact_replay.z: 2+i (algebra regression only; not the natural prime pool)

remaining_terms.aliases: actual phases exp(i*T*sum epsilon_j log(n_j)) and section endpoint kernel remain; no exact or near-alias cancellation is certified here
remaining_terms.first_unresolved_sum: uniform source-weighted signed bound for R/d' at natural N, over the original admissible contiguous sections, with all prime powers and carrier phases
remaining_terms.repeated_vs_distinct: the finite n1,n2,n3 expansion permits exact grouping by repeated base/proper power/all-distinct; previously proved full-section moment removals do not transfer to these boundary weights
remaining_terms.sign: no positivity follows: diagonal beta is signed and the commutator blocks are Hermitian but indefinite

scalar_sector_bound.crossing_count: number of ordered (i in I,j notin I) with |j-i|=r is 2*min(r,d')
scalar_sector_bound.natural_cutoff: d'~T*L, H_d'=O(L), N~(T/(2*pi))*exp(-sqrt(L)); normalized scalar sector=O(exp(-sqrt(L))/L^2)=o(1)
scalar_sector_bound.prime_power_mass: PNT/Chebyshev with a_phi bounded away from zero gives S=O(sqrt(N)/L), including all prime powers
scalar_sector_bound.scope: only the exact scalar-background summand is shown o(1); this is not the complete boundary correction

source.inherited_gates: a_phi(T)->1, s0(T)->1, d'~T*L, full natural prime-power cutoff
source.operator: H=s0(T)I+V; V=diag(beta)+[diag(A),J], J_ij=1/(pi*(j-i)) for i!=j, J_ii=0
source.scale: L=log X, X=T/(2*pi), N=floor(X*exp(-sqrt(L))), d=floor(T*L/(2*pi)); d'/d->1

source_expansion.all_signs_and_aliases: retained in z_n and conjugation implicit in real/imaginary fields; no frequency/alias class is discarded
source_expansion.entry: v_ij=delta_ij*beta_i+(1-delta_ij)*(A_i-A_j)/(pi*(j-i)); A_i=sum_n Im(z_n exp(2*pi*i*i*alpha_n)); beta_i=sum_n 2*(1-alpha_n) Re(z_n exp(2*pi*i*i*alpha_n))
source_expansion.exact_finite_prime_power_triple_expansio: R= sum_{n1,n2,n3<=N prime powers} [2 Tr_P(Vn1_PP Vn2_PQ Vn3_QP)+Tr_P(Vn1_PQ Vn2_QQ Vn3_QP)]
source_expansion.index_trace_interpretation: for each fixed T,N, the index sums are the trace-class pairings of the displayed blocks; no rearrangement into unsigned nonconvergent sums is assumed

title: Finite-section cubic block identity and scalar boundary sector
